name: YANG Catalog (deployment)
description: Docker-compose deployment for the YANG Catalog platform. Includes YANG validation services, module search, metadata extraction, and a full web UI for browsing and analyzing YANG models from IETF, vendors, and OpenConfig.

docker_support.docker_evidence: Full docker-compose deployment with OpenSearch, RabbitMQ, Redis, NGINX, and custom YANG Catalog services. Production instance runs at yangcatalog.org.

eval_notes: Complete YANG model catalog and validation platform. Docker-compose deploys full stack including search, validation, and web UI. Good for large-scale YANG model analysis. IETF-backed project. The canonical YANG module catalog (yangcatalog.org). Includes validator, search, impact analysis, and module comparison. Complex multi-service deployment but provides the most comprehensive YANG module registry available.
